# Personal portfolio

Product: a one-page portfolio for Ida Berg, a frontend engineer, so that hiring managers can read her experience and email her. Sections in order: hero, about, experience, contact. No blog, no accounts, no forms.

Engineering: Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, exported as static files. Content lives in one JSON file. Pattern is not fixed.

Look: three fixed colours. Ink #111111 for text, cream #F3EEE3 for the background, orange #D9541E for buttons. Light theme only.

Acceptance:
- The page shows the four sections in order, with the words from the content file.
- The email link opens a new message to ida@example.com.
- The page passes WCAG 2.2 AA.
